help.title: MarkCraft keys
help.body:
Files
Ctrl+O — open
Ctrl+S — save
Ctrl+Shift+S — save as
Ctrl+N — new window

Editing
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y — undo and redo
Ctrl+B — bold
Ctrl+I — italic
Ctrl+Shift+X — strikethrough
Ctrl+K — link
Ctrl+click a link — open in browser

Search
Ctrl+F — find
Ctrl+H — find and replace
Enter / Ctrl+G — next, Shift+Enter — previous, Esc — close

View
Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0 — text size
Ctrl+wheel — same
Ctrl+Shift+C — copy as HTML

Full screen is an Omarchy hotkey, not the app's.
